summary: 025 resolves D03-RE-004: project ordinals are assigned/frozen only when a Change actually enters Explore, current Change 2 durably records 021, planned Change 3 remains unassigned with 022 only a candidate, and Archive reuses rather than allocates/recomputes the number. One optional projectOrdinal field on the existing Change coordination entry is accepted as the minimum durable fact; semantic ChangeId remains the canonical identity. Complexity is minimal/required and there is no scope drift.
